title: Same Day Delhi Private Guided City Tour
summary: Old and New Delhi in one day with a private AC car, English-speaking guide, entrance fees and a rickshaw ride.
highlights: Private AC car for all sightseeing
inclusions: Private AC car for all sightseeing

importantInfo.title: Booking & payment
importantInfo.body: Reserve now, pay later: book with a 15% advance deposit and pay the balance during the tour, or choose pay on arrival. Accepted: cash on arrival, credit card or PayPal.

importantInfo.title: Cancellation
importantInfo.body: Same-day excursions can be cancelled up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund.

importantInfo.title: Pickup & drop-off
importantInfo.body: Any hotel in Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon or the surrounding region, as well as Delhi airport. Please share your pickup location when booking.

importantInfo.title: Private tour
importantInfo.body: Only your group participates, with a dedicated AC vehicle, driver and guide.

importantInfo.title: Guide languages
importantInfo.body: Live guides are available in English, Spanish, German, French, Russian and Japanese.
